items.title: 68189_Al Hall oral history interview
items.q: He was the backbone of the trumpet section and then we had Doc Cheatham, Karl George and , well, I already mentioned the reed section.

ctx.x: Anyway, So to get back to Teddy then, you were talking about Shorty Baker, that's what you were going to say. You called him, you had a name for him?
Why did you call him Hyphitz? Jascha Heifitz.
